title: A Very Long and Detailed Ranking of Almost Everything I Watched in 2023

commenti.body: I was set to fixate on what we disagree with until I got to your number one. I too am a believer in Babylon. I’m a huge fan of Chazelle’s, a huge fan of epic absurd period pieces, and a huge fan of Singing in the Rain (if you haven’t seen this classic it is terrific and a huge inspiration for Babylon).

>I was set to fixate on what we disagree with until I got to your number one.

Glad to know Babylon worked for you as well. What do you disagree with, though?

What sticks out most is Napoleon. I found it to be quite a clunker with a couple rousing battles thrown in. It’s probably my biggest disappointment of the year since Scott is one of my all time favorite directors. I’m dubious his extended edition can salvage it for me.
I see. Is there anything else? I imagine my placement of Maestro, Hunger Games and Guardians might be controversial.
